## Helper (HelperPinguino, owner: Helper fork of 02)

Engine: `HelperPinguino\PinguinoHelper.cs` (C# 7.3; an INDEX block with line numbers sits at the top of the file). Tests: `Tests\helper\run-helper-tests.ps1` (harness.cs), `python -I Tools\test-helper-pack.py`.

| Area | Where |
|---|---|
| Message pipeline, gates, cooldowns, opt-outs | `Handle()` / `HandleCore()` |
| `!helper` / `!ask` / `!pinguino` (pack answers, tiers, unanswered log) | section "!helper <question>" |
| Random chime (rate-limited tips, never for opted-out / !unping) | `TryChime`, `OptedOutOfBots` |
| Context gate, lobby/join/register help, Minecraft + site facts, Taught notes | sections of the same names |
| Help-review log (private) | `Data\helper\review.jsonl`, browsed at /helper-review (Host `HostHelperReview.cs`) |
| Settings | `HelperSettings` (`Data\runtime\helper_settings.json`) |

Knowledge pack (PUBLIC material only goes through these):
- Builder `Tools\build-helper-pack.py` -> `Data\helper\knowledge.json` (public tier) and `knowledge_mod.json` (mod tier, role >= 3). Rebuilt nightly (`Docs\NIGHTLY_CHECKLIST.md`).
- Hand-written public summaries: `Docs\HELPER_PUBLIC.md` (one `## Title` per entry). Mod how-tos: `Docs\HELPER_MOD.md`.
- Other sources: `PinguinoB0t\commands.json`, `Data\runtime\helper_facts.json` (+ Taught), `links.json`, `channel_lore.json` (info + link, publicSafe), site FAQ.
- Never in the public pack: secrets, `Data\lore`, raw logs, opted-out people, internal architecture (enforced by the builder, checked by the leak test).
- Unanswered questions: `Docs\nightly\YYYY-MM-DD.md`, section "Helper unanswered".
